title: The Long Run: A Parkrun Record of Progress, Patience and a Mid-2021 Breakthrough
summary: A 118-event parkrun record shows how a genuine 2021 breakthrough sits inside a wider distribution shaped by form, age grade, season and uncertainty.
key_takeaway: The 2021 personal best was part of a concentrated performance peak, but progress remains a range rather than a permanently reset baseline.

inline_figures.caption: The long-term time series reveals a concentrated mid-2021 run of progressively faster performances.
Age-grade performance rises with the 2021 breakthrough and begins improving again near the end of the record.
Average run time by calendar month across August 2018–May 2025; lower bars indicate faster performance.
Historical results and a 26-week forecast show a wide uncertainty interval around a central expectation above the 2021 personal best.
A large-format synthesis board that brings the article's five principal pieces of evidence into one readable argument.
